item.title: The ​EBA extends some consultation deadlines due to website maintenance​
item.description: On 21 October 2026, CERT-EU, the cybersecurity service for the EU institutions, bodies and agencies, alerted organisations to two critical security flaws in software used to run many websites, including that of the European Banking Authority (EBA). As a precaution, the EBA took its website offline on Wednesday 21 October 2026 at 13:00 CEST while the necessary security updates were applied. The website was restored on Thursday 22 October 2026 at 14:00 CEST. — Thématique réglementation ; source jugée fiable (european banking authority) ; impact réglementaire.
